summary: Iter-135 (Saudi-timezone default dates) and Iter-134-Auto (BNPL Auto/Manual commission_mode toggle) fully validated end-to-end against the preview URL. Backend: 5/5 unit tests + 8/8 new live API round-trip tests (tabby+tamara) pass — GET defaults to commission_mode='auto', PUT manual+mdr persists, invalid mode ignored, PUT auto resets. Frontend: 7/7 FinancialInputHub date inputs (liab-due-date, pay-date, dexp-date, rec-due, adv-date, ship-date, cod-date) prefill with today in Asia/Riyadh (2026-06-12). /transfers New Transfer modal `transfer-date` and /accounts add-account `account-opening-date-input` also prefill correctly. /integrations/bnpl: both tabby and tamara cards expose bnpl-{provider}-mode-toggle with -auto and -manual buttons; clicking Auto applies the exact preset numbers (Tabby: mdr=0.0699, fixed=1, vat=0.15, refundable=0.0499, settlement=6 ; Tamara: 0.07/0/0.15/0.07/0) and disables all 5 rate inputs; Manual re-enables them. Saving in Manual then reloading the page preserves the mode (amber active on manual button, MDR input remains enabled) — persistence confirmed both via DB GET and via UI reload.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor doc nit: review_request says hub URL is /financial-input/hub but App.js mounts it at /financial-input-hub. The data-testid for accounts modal is `account-opening-date-input` (not `opening_balance_date`). Rate-input testids are bnpl-{p}-mdr, bnpl-{p}-fixed-fee, bnpl-{p}-vat, bnpl-{p}-refundable-pct, bnpl-{p}-settlement-fee (review_request listed slightly different names). All work as-is; just update the spec.

BnplIntegrations.jsx active-state colors differ between buttons (auto=emerald-600, manual=amber-600). This is intentional and visually clear, but the review_request implied both should be 'emerald-colored when active' — confirm the design intent is auto=emerald/manual=amber (currently the case).
dates.js helpers use `Date.now() + 3h` then `toISOString().slice(0,10)`. Correct for Asia/Riyadh (no DST). No issues.
config_store.save_settings correctly ignores invalid commission_mode values (verified) and persists 'manual'/'auto' atomically. Good guard rail.
seed_data_creation: Test toggled tabby commission_mode to manual then restored to auto at end. No persistent test-only data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct URLs/testids for future iterations: /financial-input-hub (NOT /financial-input/hub); /integrations/bnpl (NOT /bnpl/integrations); accounts add-account date input is data-testid='account-opening-date-input'; BNPL rate inputs are bnpl-{tabby|tamara}-{mdr|fixed-fee|vat|refundable-pct|settlement-fee}; active toggle classes are bg-emerald-600 (auto) and bg-amber-600 (manual). Hub forms are lazy-mounted per tab — must click hub-tab-{id} before the date input becomes queryable in DOM. Expected Riyadh date matches `(datetime.utcnow() + 3h).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')`.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial false-FAIL on persistence test was a test-script bug (looked for 'emerald' substring in manual button class, but manual uses 'amber'). Corrected and confirmed PERSISTENCE: OK.
